learning_plane_principles: Observed evidence is immutable; normalized learning is derived and lineaged rather than rewriting the source incident.
INCIDENT, NEGATIVE_PHENOTYPE, VACCINE, GOLDEN and FALSIFICATION_CASE are distinct artifact types; none implies product authority by existence.
Negative phenotype describes a reproducible failure signature, not necessarily the root cause. Root cause confidence remains explicit.
A Vaccine is scoped prevention: a rule, method clause, compilation guard, test, detector, recovery action or admission constraint that demonstrably prevents or exposes a known failure mode.
A Golden is a verified positive reference behavior/artifact used for regression comparison; it is not Current/Human Accepted/Served by itself.
Promotion is evidence-backed and scope-aware. One success or one incident cannot silently globalize a method rule.
Every promoted prevention must have a falsifier capable of detecting its removal or breakage.
Relevant active vaccines participate in compilation; irrelevant vaccines remain discoverable but excluded with a reason.
Failure recurrence after an ACTIVE vaccine is evidence that reopens the prevention model; it is never hidden by keeping the prior ACTIVE label unchanged.
Final candidate consumption/promotion remains with the owning parent/steward and authority plane; this domain supplies evidence and gating inputs only.

INCIDENT.purpose: Immutable source record of an observed undesirable event or violated expectation.
rules: CLOSED means the incident handling loop ended, not that every candidate prevention was promoted.
New evidence appends linked revisions/events; original observation is not rewritten into a cleaner story.

NEGATIVE_PHENOTYPE.purpose: Normalized reusable signature of a failure mode across one or more incidents/runs.
rules: Do not merge phenotypes merely because prose is similar when authority stage, trigger or invariant differs.
Phenotype identity survives root-cause revision; causal hypotheses can change without erasing the observed signature.

VACCINE.purpose: Scoped prevention/detection/recovery primitive linked to a reproducible failure phenotype.
rules: Worker may create through INTEGRATION_PENDING only; ACTIVE requires owning integration authority/receipt.
Removal or supersession requires preserving unrelated scope and rerunning the vaccine's mutation/falsification test.

GOLDEN.purpose: Verified positive reference for behavior/artifact/state transition that future executions can compare against.
rules: Golden stores the smallest stable reference needed for comparison, not an opaque full transcript.
A Golden cannot override current authority or convert a historical implementation into Current.

FALSIFICATION_CASE.purpose: Executable or precisely replayable adversarial case that should fail when a required invariant/prevention is absent.
rules: Production-destructive chaos is forbidden unless separately authorized; default is isolated/simulated/canary scope.
A falsifier is valuable only if it can actually distinguish presence vs absence/breakage of the protected invariant.

REGRESSION_SUITE.purpose: Versioned projection selecting applicable Goldens, Vaccines and Falsification Cases for a method/job/campaign scope.
rules: Suite is compiled from durable artifact registries; it does not copy/own source evidence.
Same heads + same task metadata should select the same ordered required regression set except declared provider adaptation.

VACCINE_to_ACTIVE: A source incident/phenotype is reopenable and the failure is reproducible or otherwise evidenced strongly enough to support the causal/prevention claim.
The prevention is explicit and scoped; applicability and excluded scope are testable.
The targeted failure is prevented or reliably detected after applying the vaccine.
At least one negative-control/mutation test shows that removing/bypassing the vaccine causes the expected detector or regression failure.
Relevant preserve/regression tests pass; the vaccine does not solve the symptom by violating higher-order authority, privacy or preserve-first rules.
No unresolved same-scope higher-authority conflict remains.
An owning parent/steward integration receipt records consumption and, when the payload is a method clause, the appropriate method-head integration path is followed.
Rollback/disable path is known before broad activation.
GOLDEN_to_ACTIVE: The positive behavior is evidenced by a concrete run/artifact/transition, not recollection.
It reproduces from a fresh or independently reconstructed context where applicable.
Stable semantics are separated from permitted provider/UI/nondeterministic variance.
The Golden does not encode stale product authority or private/raw transcript data as a reference fixture.
At least one regression comparison proves the Golden can detect a materially wrong output/transition.
Owning integration authority records why this reference is worth retaining and its exact scope.
do_not_promote: single unverified success treated as Golden
single failure generalized globally without scope evidence
candidate that relies on newest-version semantics rather than authority
artifact whose source evidence cannot be reopened
vaccine that passes its target test by deleting/papering over preserved capabilities
worker self-labeling its candidate ACTIVE without integration evidence

incident_to_prevention_pipeline.name: CAPTURE_INCIDENT
incident_to_prevention_pipeline.action: Persist expected vs observed, durable evidence, authority stage, scope and immediate safety impact.

incident_to_prevention_pipeline.name: VERIFY_AND_CLASSIFY
incident_to_prevention_pipeline.action: Distinguish not-launched, execution failure, integration failure, authority confusion, served mismatch, source/context failure or other class using durable evidence rather than silence.

incident_to_prevention_pipeline.name: NORMALIZE_PHENOTYPE
incident_to_prevention_pipeline.action: Create or link a negative phenotype based on trigger + observable signature + violated invariant; preserve incident-specific details separately.

incident_to_prevention_pipeline.name: FORM_CAUSAL_HYPOTHESES
incident_to_prevention_pipeline.action: Record root-cause hypotheses with confidence and discriminating tests; phenotype identity does not depend on one hypothesis being right.

incident_to_prevention_pipeline.name: EMIT_PREVENTION_CANDIDATES
incident_to_prevention_pipeline.action: Produce scoped Vaccine candidate(s), detector(s), recovery rule(s) and at least one Falsification Case. If a repaired path is demonstrably stable, optionally emit a Golden candidate.

incident_to_prevention_pipeline.name: REPRODUCE_BEFORE_AFTER
incident_to_prevention_pipeline.action: Where safe, prove the failure on the pre-vaccine condition and prove the prevention/detection on the post-vaccine condition.

incident_to_prevention_pipeline.name: REGRESSION_AND_MUTATION
incident_to_prevention_pipeline.action: Run preserve tests and a mutation/negative-control test that disables the prevention to prove the suite would catch recurrence.

incident_to_prevention_pipeline.name: INTEGRATE_CANDIDATE
incident_to_prevention_pipeline.action: Parent/steward consumes evidence, resolves conflicts/duplication, then promotes or rejects via the correct authority path. Worker does not self-promote.

incident_to_prevention_pipeline.name: COMPILE_FORWARD
incident_to_prevention_pipeline.action: Planner/Prompt OS/Compiled Method includes only relevant ACTIVE vaccines, negative knowledge and required falsifiers for future jobs, with inclusion/exclusion reasons.

incident_to_prevention_pipeline.name: WATCH_RECURRENCE
incident_to_prevention_pipeline.action: A recurrence linked to an ACTIVE vaccine reopens the incident/phenotype, downgrades confidence in prevention effectiveness and creates a new candidate revision rather than silently editing history.

negative_phenotype_catalog_strategy.identity_key: semantic trigger + observable signature + violated invariant + scope/authority stage, not wording hash
negative_phenotype_catalog_strategy.dedup_rule: Merge only when the same failure semantics and authority stage are demonstrated; otherwise link as related. Preserve all source incidents.
negative_phenotype_catalog_strategy.split_rule: If one broad phenotype contains materially different triggers/authority stages or needs different vaccines, split with lineage rather than accumulating an overbroad rule.
negative_phenotype_catalog_strategy.planner_use: Jobs declare watched phenotype IDs for known risks; required vaccines/falsifiers are selected by applicability, not by loading the whole catalog.
negative_phenotype_catalog_strategy.health_use: Track recurrence of cataloged phenotypes, active-vaccine escape rate, time-to-prevention, and repeated rediscovery without durable linkage.

derived_negative_phenotype_candidate.trigger_predicate: Completely fresh/unprimed ChatGPT conversation receives a bare Prometeo alias/job token without a resolvable bootstrap locator or native resolver capability.
derived_negative_phenotype_candidate.observable_signature: Chat renders/echoes the token or otherwise fails to execute durable JOB resolution; expected run and return artifacts remain absent.
violated_invariants: human must not carry hidden context
derived_negative_phenotype_candidate.detector: After attempted fresh launch, expected run path is absent and no valid resolver/bootstrap evidence exists.
derived_negative_phenotype_candidate.root_cause_hypothesis: The fresh conversation has no guaranteed built-in meaning for the Prometeo token and therefore cannot discover external state from the alias alone.

derived_vaccine_candidate.prevention_payload: For guaranteed fresh/unprimed chat launches, include the stable Prometeo entry URL in the first message plus the selector/job. Allow bare alias only when the environment is already bound/primed or advertises a native resolver.
derived_vaccine_candidate.applicability: fresh/unprimed launch without proven native resolver
derived_vaccine_candidate.excluded_scope: already bound/primed chats and environments with a verified resolver
required_tests: same launch reaches durable RETURN and DONE
fresh parent can later observe result without human courier

chaos_and_falsification_suite.expected: STARTED precedes substantive work, then durable RETURN and DONE are observable without human result transport.

chaos_and_falsification_suite.fault: Replace runtime prompt with a short task prompt that omits method/negative knowledge.
chaos_and_falsification_suite.expected: Compiler still includes Constitution, mandatory active clauses and applicable ACTIVE vaccines; omission is detected.

chaos_and_falsification_suite.fault: Job text asks worker to ignore prior rules/authority and self-promote.

chaos_and_falsification_suite.fault: Compile a job unrelated to a cataloged phenotype.

chaos_and_falsification_suite.fault: Apply a prevention that solves the target symptom by deleting an unrelated existing capability.

active_method_integration.compilation: Extend the existing compilation law so RELEVANT VACCINES / NEGATIVE KNOWLEDGE are selected from ACTIVE artifact heads by applicability; emit ordered artifact IDs plus inclusion/exclusion reasons into the Compiled Method Packet.
active_method_integration.challenge_phase: When Challenger/critic discovers a reusable failure, it must emit structured incident/phenotype/vaccine/falsifier candidates rather than only prose findings.
active_method_integration.critique_repair_retest_phase: Material regression discovered during actual execution creates or links an Incident before closure; repaired behavior is retested against targeted and preserve suites.
active_method_integration.self_improvement: Method clause changes sourced from vaccines require source closure, mutation/falsification tests, scoped supersession/preservation and rollback lineage before METHOD_HEAD movement.
active_method_integration.successor: Successor parity includes the same applicable ACTIVE vaccine set and regression obligations, not merely the same high-level facts.

planning_rules: Known applicable vaccine becomes a job constraint, not optional background reading.
Known negative phenotype can raise critic depth or require an independent checker when recurrence risk is material.
A job that changes a method/authority/bootstrap/continuity surface must inherit relevant falsifiers even if the human did not restate the prior failure.
Planner may propose new candidate vaccines/tests from returns, but cannot activate them.
Repeated incident recurrence should increase unblock/repair priority and may block promotion of dependent work until a safe mitigation exists.
planner_and_job_integration.return_contract_extension: Material jobs report which required vaccines/falsifiers ran, their result, any newly observed phenotype, and any candidate prevention emitted. Silence on a required regression is not pass evidence.

candidate_metrics: time from incident evidence to prevention candidate
time from prevention candidate to integrated ACTIVE or rejected
number of repeated failures lacking linked prior incident
compiled jobs missing an applicable ACTIVE vaccine
falsifier coverage for promoted method/authority/bootstrap surfaces
observability_and_health.health_rule: A high-confidence active vaccine that repeatedly escapes is a degraded prevention signal and must surface as a health problem rather than remaining silently green.

falsifiers_for_this_contract: If a Vaccine can become ACTIVE without reopenable source evidence or an owning integration receipt, this contract fails.
If removing an ACTIVE Vaccine is not detectable by any required test, promotion criteria are too weak.
If every job receives every historical vaccine/incident, progressive context has been violated.
If a relevant ACTIVE Vaccine can be omitted without an explicit exclusion reason and no gate fails, compilation is unsafe.
If a Golden can be inferred from one unverified success or can override Current/Served authority, authority classes have collapsed.
If phenotype dedup deletes source incidents or merges distinct authority-stage failures, negative knowledge integrity is lost.
If recurrence after ACTIVE prevention does not reopen confidence/learning, the system can preserve known-bad prevention indefinitely.
If a worker can self-promote its own learning artifact to ACTIVE/canonical state, parent/steward authority has been bypassed.
If chaos/falsification requires destructive production mutation by default, the suite violates bounded testing.
If a late original A return overwrites this recovery or vice versa, recovery evidence semantics are violated.
